title: Dropping a length-sized prefix is polynomial-time
statement: For a bit string $z$, let $a$ and $b$ be the two components decoded from $z$ by the aligned pair parser, using the empty word for each total projection when decoding fails. The function that drops from $b$ its first $|a|$ bits is polynomial-time computable.
